B direct-read paired16 SA3.125/PC4.000/Joint5 versus normal request-bound3.0625/3.8125/6. Preserve a direct physical value route; avoid forcing all physical execution through serial request binding. State interaction also supports two Joint cases despite a PC mean cost.

design.change: Restore direct physical read and state-dependent write with independent physical Q/K/V/O

design.change: Add native-request response conditioned by the local physical read
design.mechanism: A full-width learned map sends the locally read physical message into native text-query coordinates. Add O_text*(Attention(q_text+shift,K_text,V_text)-Attention(q_text,K_text,V_text)). The keys/values/O are the SAME frozen native request maps; native O bias cancels. Direct physical writing remains active and unattenuated.
design.purpose: Give generation training a direct way to couple physics to the requested entity/role/process using original prompt semantics, without serially replacing the direct physical read or adding a freely learned text-value bank.
design.limitation: This is a new mechanism hypothesis. It can still learn harmful changes and must improve complete40 and actual videos. Functional tests establish wiring/gradients, not success.
